newsitem.title: UK: UK's Caird sees stable H1 profit.
newsitem.headline: UK's Caird sees stable H1 profit.

text.p: British waste management group Caird Group Plc said on Wednesday it expected first half profits to at least match the year-earlier result.
"All divisions continue to perform profitably and ahead of expectations with almost all locations showing an improvement over the early part of 1996," Caird said.
It noted that the profits would at least match the year-ago period despite a major one-off contract last year at its landfill division.
Caird reported a 7.98 million stg pretax profit for the six months to June 30, 1996.
